query:
SELECT rating::text AS rating, note, created_at
                       FROM agent_response_feedback
                       WHERE user_id = $1
                         AND subject_kind = $2::text::agent_response_feedback_subject
                         AND container_id = $3
                         AND subject_id = $4
                         AND turn IS NULL
                       ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
                       LIMIT 1
